Author: CheesyChiz
Name: Stock Manager
Punchline: Balances Island Sanctuary stock with imported Visland routes.
Description: Check the Island resources you want, set their stock levels, and let Stock Manager choose the best imported Visland routes automatically. Detects flight and tool access, supports optional Lifestream travel and configurable surplus export, and includes an experimental mixed-resource route generator. Open with /stockmanager or /sm.
Changelog: Added resource checkboxes, automatic route and flight handling, optional Lifestream Island travel, and an experimental mixed-resource route generator.
